Class AccountSyncService

public inherited sharing class AccountSyncService
implements RestService

Service handler for synchronizing venue/account data from Firebase/Firestore to Salesforce. Invoked by the BlazeBiteIntegrationService REST endpoint for the syncAccount action. Implements the RestService interface for standardized request/response handling. Uses FieldMappingEngine with SYNC_FIRESTOREVENUE_ACCOUNT settings for dynamic field mapping, performs address parsing via AddressUtils, and upserts accounts using ExternalId__c as the external ID field. Provides comprehensive error logging for failed operations.

public static RestServiceResponse execute(
  RestRequest req,
  String service
)

Implements/Overrides: RestService.execute(RestRequest,String)

Processes account synchronization requests from Firebase/Firestore. Maps the JSON request body to an Account SObject using FieldMappingEngine, validates the ExternalId__c field, parses and populates billing address fields, and performs an upsert operation. Returns appropriate success or error responses with detailed error logging for failures.

Parameters:
    req – RestRequest object containing the JSON payload with account data to sync
    service – Action name identifier, expected value is syncAccount

Returns:
    RestServiceResponse: Success response (204) or error response (406) with details
